subject: Six-track iterative DKC soundtrack production
question: Is actual source-led and expressive soundtrack production commissioned?
decision: Revise the four existing DKC studies and make two additional tracks. First compare instrument selection and tonality against the reference documents and originals, then develop live-instrument-style performances iteratively toward subjectively high quality, with an estimated 10–25 revisions as useful. Retain and assess valuable alternate inspirations/takes and finish with the critical artistic decisions as guidance for the remaining production. This directly authorizes these private arrangements; final owner/runtime acceptance is separate.
